title: How is progress measured in Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle for children with autism?
metaTitle: Measuring Progress in Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle for Children with Autism
description: Learn how progress is measured in Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle for children with autism. Formal assessments, therapist observations, and caregiver feedback are utilized to track improvements.
html: Progress is measured against the goals set at the beginning of therapy. This can involve formal assessments, therapist observations, and feedback from the child’s caregivers. The improvements in the child’s ability to carry out day-to-day activities and interact socially are considered too.
